description: FDA boxed warnings — FDA black-box (boxed) warnings from openFDA drug labeling. drug= (brand or generic, e.g. Chantix, lisinopril, oxycodone) returns whether the NEWEST matching label carries a boxed warning, its text, detected topics (suicidality, addiction/abuse, respiratory depression, hepatotoxicity, cardiovascular, QT, serious infections, malignancy, embryo-fetal toxicity, dementia mortality, bleeding, REMS...) and a note when older labels still show a warning FDA removed (e.g. Chantix). term= (e.g. hepatotoxicity, suicidal, QT) lists the generic drugs whose boxed warning mentions it, by label count (limit= up to 200). Not medical advice. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: fda_boxed_warnings
